g.text: Tell me more of this future
The one where the gods are hungry but have no meaning to you
The future you claim you've given up for us
Of these wars and distant worlds
You're going to have to narrow it down a bit...
The spiders are at it again
No importa, ya no te molesto
The spiders are at it again
No importa, ya no te molesto
You've mentioned the spiders before. A metaphor for depression, I assume?
Proof that spiders make shitty pets, I guess?
Something I've had all my life
Stupid little things in my head that tell me lies
Just a name I use for the things in my head that tell me lies
Spiders are what I call the things in my head that tell me lies
Little things that whisper to me things that I believe when I am too stupid and fall for it
What do you mean, they tell you lies?
What do they whisper to you?
Little things that whisper to me in my head words that I believe when I am too stupid and fall for it
At least you know the spiders are liars, but... they sound like total assholes.
Mine say meaner things... you're lucky.
Have you considered medication or treatment for it? Depression can be serious.
Lo siento, hate to whine at you
This kind of sadness is small but it can be a poison if you let it get too strong
Mi mamá had it all her life so I have seen the toll it takes
Then you truly understand what it's like, mi corazón
But they are liars remember that always
This kind of sadness is small but it can be a poison if you let it get too strong
Mi mamá had it all her life so I have seen the toll it takes
Mi mamá had it all her life
So I have seen the toll it can take
Luckily, mine is not that bad, does not escalate into very serious things
Have tried medication before, but hate the fog it brings
But here is why I call them spiders
Because you can take a newspaper and roll it up into a tube
They are small and easily broken
But here is why I call them spiders
Because you can take a newspaper and roll it up into a tube
They are small and easily broken
I do not wish to dance with La Flaca, do not fret
Nor do I wish for pain that does not come with pleasure jajaja
It is a mild sadness, the spiders are small ones
You're not going to like Venus...
Very fair. And now, I can help you crush the spiders.
You're not going to like Venus...
Very fair. And now, we can help each other crush the spiders.
I trust you. But you know when to get help, right?
If it ever got bad... you'd tell me, right? Even if we weren't still together?
Never mind. At least now, I can help you crush the spiders.
And I thank you for that
But now I have to go back to work as always
Never mind. At least now, we can crush the spiders together.
But now I have to go back to work as always
I will remember this moment and that you cared and I will roll it up like a newspaper and crush the spiders jajaja
But I have to go back to work now
